name: @ship/studio
description: Ship Studio pack — <ship-component-catalog>, <ship-component-viewer>. The hub /studio/components surface; composes <sui-card> / <sui-stack> / <sui-empty-state> / <sui-icon> / <sui-badge> from @ship/sui-primitives. The catalog + component source data are a known BACKEND-GAP (no `ship.ui.*` SDK op + the shell's purged `/_deck/catalog/workspace` endpoint); the components degrade to documented empty-states until the gap closes. Wired by `apps/hub/routes/studio/components/`. Reuses the existing per-package `deck.bundles` self-declaration (the framework discovers it the same way as `@ship/home`).
